hazards.evidence: A white bath mat is hanging over the edge of the tub and touching the floor, which could become loose or slip when stepped on.

The tub has a high step-over, and although a shower chair is present, it is not positioned as a transfer aid at the tub edge; the dog is occupying the tub, indicating the chair is not being used for transfer.
A small dog is lying inside the bathtub, which is an unexpected obstacle and could cause a fall if the person steps into the tub without noticing.
